notes: Registration input, not a run input: Binance spot 1-minute klines for ETHUSDT, pulled exactly as source-binance-btcusdt-1m.json (same transform, layout and knobs). ETHUSDT is quoted in USDT, a proxy for, not a copy of, the USD CF Benchmarks ETH index that Kalshi settles on. Time: a kline is labelled by its bar START (open_time_ms); the bar is known only after close_time_ms, so a feature may use only bars already closed at decision time. Columns are epoch ms (Kalshi candle ts is seconds). LICENCE: Binance Vision data is CC BY-NC-SA (https://data.binance.vision/Binance_Vision-Terms_of_Use.pdf): research use only, not for live trading features. Dates: configs/binance_vision_dates.json, pinned by entities_sha256 (export CRYPTO_TRADING_ROOT=<this child's root>; no machine path is stored). The untouched vendor zip is kept at _raw/<date>.zip and its sha256 is the inventory raw_sha256: compare it with the vendor's <file>.zip.CHECKSUM (ADR-0238 withdrawn; manual spot check per runbook). HEAD sweep 2026-10-06 of every date in configs/binance_vision_dates.json: 0 days returned 404; max_refused 3 is headroom only, for a day missing at pull time. A day Binance lacks lands as a refused inventory row (suite-binance-files.json warns, never blocks) instead of aborting a pull of over a thousand files. throttle_s 0.1 is polite to a static archive; max_bytes 50 MB is a sanity cap (a daily zip is about 70 KB). A changed declaration (dates, pin or as_of) re-pulls; an unchanged one is a no-op. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source binance-ethusdt-1m --catalog-source binance-ethusdt-1m --connector httpblobs --config @configs/source-binance-ethusdt-1m.json --activate --root <store root>; then acquire --source binance-ethusdt-1m --stream files --mode backfill; validate with configs/suite-binance-files.json.
